formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Fin (7 : ℕ) → Fin (7 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x1 x2 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) => x1 = x2 ∨ x1 = x2 + (1 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) ∨ x1 = x2 + (3 : Fin (7 : ℕ)); have x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => x2.size ≤ (27 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x3 : ℕ) (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x3]? = Option.some x4 → (x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x4.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x6 : ℕ) (x7 : ℕ), x4.inputs = [x6, x7] ∧ x6 ≠ x7 ∧ x6 < (14 : ℕ) + x3 ∧ x7 < (14 : ℕ) + x3) ∧ ∀ (x3 : Fin (14 : ℕ) → Bool), x2.eval (List.ofFn x3) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x4 : Fin (7 : ℕ)) (x5 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), x1 x4 x5 ∧ x3 (Fin.castAdd (7 : ℕ) x4) = Bool.true ∧ x3 (Fin.natAdd (7 : ℕ) x5) = Bool.true; have x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (List.filter (fun (x4 : ℕ) => Decidable.decide ((14 : ℕ) ≤ x4)) (x3.output :: List.flatMap PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate.inputs x3.gates)).Nodup; ∀ (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x5 x6 : Fin (7 : ℕ)), x2 x4 → x3 x4 → x1 x5 x6 → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree (14 : ℕ) {↑x5} x4 (1 : ℕ) ∨ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree (14 : ℕ) {(7 : ℕ) + ↑x6} x4 (1 : ℕ))
plain_statement: It is false that: Fano plane (7 point inputs, 7 line inputs). C a circuit of at most 27 AND and OR gates, each reading two different earlier wires, computing the incidence function, in which no gate's wire is read twice and the output is read by no gate. Then for every incident point p and line l, C has degree at most 1 in the input of p or in the input of l.
